bagPolicy.summary: Life Is Beautiful has not announced a current festival edition or current bag policy. Historical rules should not be used for a future event.
bagPolicy.note: Use the organizer's official channel for any return announcement and edition-specific entry requirements.

parking.note: No current festival site or parking plan is published. Historical resale parking listings are not official transportation guidance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Life Is Beautiful's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Life is Beautiful 2023 offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including a curated Pizzeria with rotating menus from top pizzaiolos and an Omakase Cantina featuring high-concept dinners. Attendees can enjoy offerings from popular Las Vegas restaurants and vendors throughout the festival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Life Is Beautiful, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Life Is Beautiful's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Life Is Beautiful. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Life Is Beautiful. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
